# Building a Sustainable Future

Together, we can protect and enhance the environment by effectively managing the lifecycle of
refrigerants to build a sustainable future.

## Welcome to A-Gas

[

REFRIGERANTS

][47] [

FIRE
PROTECTION

][48] [

ENVIRONMENTAL
SERVICES

][49] [

CARBON
CREDITS

][50]

# Products and Services

Refrigeration and air conditioning is critical to the way we live. A‑Gas plays a crucial role in
this and it is likely that you come into contact with our products every day.

A‑Gas is a world leader in the supply and lifecycle management of refrigerants and associated
products and services. For over 30 years, through our first-class recovery, reclamation, and
repurposing processes, we have been capturing refrigerant gas for future re-use or safe destruction,
preventing its harmful release into the atmosphere.

[ Products and Services ][51]

# Together, We Can

Our unwavering commitment puts A‑Gas at the forefront of our industry in terms of sustainability and
supporting the circular economy. We are continuously focused on how our products can impact the
planet and how our services and expertise can protect our environment.

[ Sustainability ][52]

# Our Net-Zero Pledge

A-Gas is committed to becoming a net-zero company by 2035. It is an ambitious target that cannot be
achieved alone, but Together, We Can.

[ A-Gas Net-Zero Pledge ][53]

# Transform Your Refrigerant Recovery Process

Streamline your processes by utilising our on-site refrigerant recovery service and save valuable
time, reduce costs and maintain business as usual.

[ Find Out More ][54]

# Global Career Opportunities

A-Gas’ purpose is to protect and enhance the environment by effectively managing the lifecycle of
refrigerants to build a sustainable future. We can only achieve this by having such exceptional
people as part of our global team.

[ Careers ][55]

# **Best drinking water filtration system**

## **Still Using Bottled Water at the Office?**

## There's a **better** (less expensive & greener) way to drink.

[ Learn More ][22]
[Most businesses save at least 30% by switching to Aqua Chill.]

## Most businesses save **at least 30%  **by switching to **Aqua Chill.**

We make purified water, fresh by the glass.  No bottles mean no plastic waste, no deliveries, and no
heavy bottles to lift—just good, clean water that’s better for the environment at a fraction of the
cost!

[THE BOTTLED WATER EFFECT]

## THE BOTTLED WATER EFFECT

Making bottles to meet America’s demand for bottled water uses more than [17 million barrels of
oil][23] annually, enough to fuel 1.3 million cars for a year. (And that’s not even including the
oil used for transportation.)

## #BanTheBottle

[Drink More Responsibly]

## Drink More **Responsibly**

U.S. landfills are overflowing with 2 million tons of discarded water bottles. As a company, you’re
in a position to make a real difference. (And your employees will notice.)

[Aqua Chill - AC-CLB-3000U]
[Aqua Chill - H20-2250HV-COOLER]

## Pull Lever **Get Water**

No more lifting, sanitizing, and storing giant jugs of water. Our one-time installation process is
easier than you think (not to mention free).

[Cleaner Water Made Fresh by the Glass]

## Cleaner Water
## **Made Fresh by the Glass**

Our technologically advanced reverse osmosis system removes dirt, biological contaminants,
chemicals, heavy metals, and minerals—seconds, not months, before you drink.

### We handle all the Service

Our team will perform rigorous maintenance on your system every 6-8 months (that’s 2-3 times more
often than the other guys). Water emergency? We’ll be there within 24 hours, and it’s on us.

# Automation Solutions for High-Stakes Operations

Emerson’s automation solutions help you unlock critical data, optimize your existing systems and
protect the investments you’ve already made.

## Emerson's Automation Solutions Optimize Performance

Emerson empowers you to modernize business operations at your pace, drive optimal performance and
deliver long-term operational excellence.

[icon]

##### Unrivaled Industrial Software

From control systems to industrial software, our advanced automation solutions power connected
operations and improve performance where it matters most.

[icon]

##### Global Support Network

Emerson’s global support and local experts offer deep market knowledge that minimizes business
disruption and keeps industrial operations running. 

[icon]

##### Proven Industry Expertise

Emerson brings decades of technical expertise and industry insight to solve the world’s most complex
operational challenges.

[icon]

##### Legacy of Innovations

Built on 135+ years of innovation, Emerson technologies and solutions are shaping the future of
industrial automation.

## Our Industrial Technology

Emerson’s automation software and sustainable solutions empower enterprise-wide performance and
efficiency.

## Feature Focus

**Linde Fuels Artemis II Launch at Kennedy Space Center**
As part of this historic launch, we delivered 200,000 gallons of liquid oxygen and deployed mobile
nitrogen tankers, supporting NASA's historic Artemis II mission-a proud milestone for our team and
our legacy in space exploration.

Our Expertise

## Gases

Gases may be invisible, but they are everywhere - helping to improve healthcare, keep food fresh,
decarbonize industry, transition to cleaner mobility, innovate microelectronics… and more
[Learn more about our gases ][122]
[""]

## Engineering

Explore how we develop and optimize gas processing by synergizing technology and engineering
leadership with execution and operational excellence.
[Learn more about our engineering portfolio][123]
[""]

## Advanced Material Technologies

We specialize in providing metal powders, surface coatings, and sputtering targets that enable
superior performance across a range of industries.
[Learn more about our advanced material technologies][124]
[""]

## Fast-forwarding the Energy Transition

From production through processing, storage & distribution to the end use application, the
infrastructure, technology and know-how are in place to kick-start the hydrogen economy now!
[Discover our expertise][125]

## Sustainability

We help customers worldwide improve their environmental performance and reduce their carbon
footprint. At the same time, we are committed to minimizing our own environmental resource
intensity.

As part of this historic launch, we delivered 200,000 gallons of liquid oxygen and deployed mobile
nitrogen tankers, supporting NASA's historic Artemis II mission-a proud milestone for our team and
our legacy in space exploration.
[Read our story on LinkedIn][121]
Our Expertise

## Gases

Gases may be invisible, but they are everywhere - helping to improve healthcare, keep food fresh,
decarbonize industry, transition to cleaner mobility, innovate microelectronics… and more
[Learn more about our gases ][122]

## Engineering

Explore how we develop and optimize gas processing by synergizing technology and engineering
leadership with execution and operational excellence.
[Learn more about our engineering portfolio][123]
[""]

## Advanced Material Technologies

We specialize in providing metal powders, surface coatings, and sputtering targets that enable
superior performance across a range of industries.
[Learn more about our advanced material technologies][124]
[""]

## Fast-forwarding the Energy Transition

From production through processing, storage & distribution to the end use application, the
infrastructure, technology and know-how are in place to kick-start the hydrogen economy now!

We help customers worldwide improve their environmental performance and reduce their carbon
footprint. At the same time, we are committed to minimizing our own environmental resource
intensity.

## What is a Refrigerant?

Refrigerant is a gas that cools the air in your home. It works by absorbing heat from the air, and
releasing that heat into the atmosphere when it evaporates. The gas is stored in liquid form and
becomes a gas again when it’s released into the air conditioning system.

Refrigerants can be made from many different chemicals, but most commonly it’s made from
chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs). These chemicals were first used in refrigerators and air conditioners
because they were non-toxic, odorless, and cheap to make. However, they have since been found to be
harmful to both humans and the environment as they break down into chlorine atoms that destroy ozone
in our atmosphere.

Today’s refrigerants are safer alternatives to CFCs, but these new chemicals are still being tested
for safety before being widely used by manufacturers.

## What is a Refrigerant?

Refrigerant is a gas that cools the air in your home. It works by absorbing heat from the air, and
releasing that heat into the atmosphere when it evaporates. The gas is stored in liquid form and
becomes a gas again when it’s released into the air conditioning system.

Refrigerants can be made from many different chemicals, but most commonly it’s made from
chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs). These chemicals were first used in refrigerators and air conditioners
because they were non-toxic, odorless, and cheap to make. However, they have since been found to be
harmful to both humans and the environment as they break down into chlorine atoms that destroy ozone
in our atmosphere.

Today’s refrigerants are safer alternatives to CFCs, but these new chemicals are still being tested
for safety before being widely used by manufacturers.

AFS Cooling provides end-to-end solutions for businesses needing to import hydrofluorocarbons (HFCs)
and other refrigerants into key global markets. We offer specialized services to ensure legal
compliance, streamline customs clearance, and simplify the entire import process. With a network of
trusted suppliers worldwide, AFS Cooling helps companies navigate the complexities of importing
refrigerants into the EU, UK, USA, AUS and Mexico.

relevant authorities. Our legal checks guarantee compliance, ensuring a smooth workflow that avoids
costly errors. With expertise in managing both the regulatory and operational complexities of

refrigerant needs.

# Your worldwide refrigerant partner

[Get in touch with us][71]

## Your worldwide refrigerant partner.

AFS Cooling provides end-to-end solutions for businesses needing to import hydrofluorocarbons (HFCs)
and other refrigerants into key global markets. We offer specialized services to ensure legal
compliance, streamline customs clearance, and simplify the entire import process. With a network of
trusted suppliers worldwide, AFS Cooling helps companies navigate the complexities of importing
refrigerants into the EU, UK, USA, AUS and Mexico.

As your importer of record, AFS Cooling ensures meticulous reporting of all import activities to
relevant authorities. Our legal checks guarantee compliance, ensuring a smooth workflow that avoids
costly errors. With expertise in managing both the regulatory and operational complexities of
refrigerant imports, AFS Cooling offers your business a hassle-free solution to meet your
refrigerant needs.

## A service to suit your every need

Your worldwide refrigerant partner

We supply virgin, reclaimed, and recycled F-Gases globally, offering flexible, high-quality
procurement solutions for all needs.

[Learn more][73]
[a man working behind a desk with headphones on]

### Compliance and Documentation

Adhering to F-Gas regulations ensures compliance, environmental protection, and operational
continuity.

[Learn more][74]

### Supply Chain and Logistics Management

We provide end-to-end support, manage logistics and cost-effective shipping from suppliers to
importers.

Viridian Exchange removes the barriers to trading environmental certificates by giving you direct
market access to a digital multilateral trading venue, built on clarity, certainty, and ease. Trade
safely at real-time prices, execute instantly, and stay fully in control, without delays or hidden
margins.

Whether you are responsible for compliance, cost control, procurement or strategic purchasing, you
need to know where you stand, what you pay, and when to act. This is the offer that Viridian
Exchange provides you with.From April 2026, Viridian will expand its offering to include the trading
of Guarantees of Origin.

## Cooling with Purpose.

AIRSYS delivers cutting-edge, mission-critical HVAC solutions designed specifically for global
digital infrastructure including hyperscale data centers and telecommunications networks. Built on
the pillars of **reliability, efficiency, and sustainability**, our ultra-efficient systems reduce
emissions, conserve water, and enhance grid stability while ensuring quiet, dependable cooling to
support high-density AI workloads and 24/7 operations.

By extending equipment life and optimizing performance, AIRSYS helps operators meet sustainability
goals and maintain mission uptime with tailored solutions built for the evolving demands of the
digital economy.

[Learn More about AIRSYS][64]

##### NEWLY LAUNCHED!

## [PowerOne™][65]

## Shaping the Future of AI-Driven, High-Capacity Data Centers

The rapid rise of Artificial Intelligence (AI), High-Performance Computing (HPC), and big data is
driving unprecedented increases in data center power density. Traditional cooling systems are
operating at the edge of what they were built to handle, leading to new challenges in efficiency,
scalability, and cost control.

Designed for ultra high-density IT loads, PowerOne delivers the innovative cooling technologies the
industry needs to meet tomorrow’s demands.

[Learn More about the PowerOne Line][66]

##### OUR MISSION

## Balance the Environment.

While manufacturing, industrial operations, and digital infrastructure will always carry an
environmental footprint, it's our responsibility to design systems that minimize that impact at
every stage.

*"Balance the Environment"* reflects our mission to push the boundaries of what efficient,
sustainable cooling looks like in mission-critical environments

#### Efficient. Reliable. Designed with Intention.

[Learn about Our Commitment to Sustainability][67]

From micro and edge deployments to enterprise, colocation, and hyperscale campuses, AIRSYS delivers
scalable cooling solutions designed for today’s AI-driven workloads and tomorrow’s infrastructure
demands. Our systems help ensure uptime, energy efficiency, and flexible growth.
[Explore Data Center Solutions][69]

### [Telecom][70]

Engineered for reliability in any environment, AIRSYS cooling systems protect telecom
infrastructure. From the access edge to core networks, our solutions reduce energy use, extend
equipment life, and ensure uninterrupted service across mobile, broadband, and 5G applications.
[Explore Telecom Solutions][71]

### [K-12 Schools][72]

Designed with students, teachers, and staff in mind, AIRSYS School Air Solutions™ provide reliable,
low-maintenance climate control for classrooms and campus facilities. Our systems improve air
quality, reduce operating costs, and meet today’s efficiency standards for school infrastructure.

[Explore School Air Solutions][73]

## Innovating with Intention.

## Cooling with Purpose.

AIRSYS delivers cutting-edge, mission-critical HVAC solutions designed specifically for global
digital infrastructure including hyperscale data centers and telecommunications networks. Built on
the pillars of **reliability, efficiency, and sustainability**, our ultra-efficient systems reduce
emissions, conserve water, and enhance grid stability while ensuring quiet, dependable cooling to
support high-density AI workloads and 24/7 operations.

By extending equipment life and optimizing performance, AIRSYS helps operators meet sustainability
goals and maintain mission uptime with tailored solutions built for the evolving demands of the
digital economy.

[Learn More about AIRSYS][64]

##### NEWLY LAUNCHED!

## [PowerOne™][65]

## Shaping the Future of AI-Driven, High-Capacity Data Centers

The rapid rise of Artificial Intelligence (AI), High-Performance Computing (HPC), and big data is
driving unprecedented increases in data center power density. Traditional cooling systems are
operating at the edge of what they were built to handle, leading to new challenges in efficiency,
scalability, and cost control.

Designed for ultra high-density IT loads, PowerOne delivers the innovative cooling technologies the
industry needs to meet tomorrow’s demands.

[Learn More about the PowerOne Line][66]

##### OUR MISSION

## Balance the Environment.

While manufacturing, industrial operations, and digital infrastructure will always carry an
environmental footprint, it's our responsibility to design systems that minimize that impact at
every stage.

*"Balance the Environment"* reflects our mission to push the boundaries of what efficient,
sustainable cooling looks like in mission-critical environments

#### Efficient. Reliable. Designed with Intention.

[Learn about Our Commitment to Sustainability][67]

### [Data Centers][68]

From micro and edge deployments to enterprise, colocation, and hyperscale campuses, AIRSYS delivers
scalable cooling solutions designed for today’s AI-driven workloads and tomorrow’s infrastructure
demands. Our systems help ensure uptime, energy efficiency, and flexible growth.
[Explore Data Center Solutions][69]

### [Telecom][70]

Engineered for reliability in any environment, AIRSYS cooling systems protect telecom
infrastructure. From the access edge to core networks, our solutions reduce energy use, extend
equipment life, and ensure uninterrupted service across mobile, broadband, and 5G applications.
[Explore Telecom Solutions][71]

### [K-12 Schools][72]

Designed with students, teachers, and staff in mind, AIRSYS School Air Solutions™ provide reliable,
low-maintenance climate control for classrooms and campus facilities. Our systems improve air
quality, reduce operating costs, and meet today’s efficiency standards for school infrastructure.

[Explore School Air Solutions][73]

AIRSYS leads the cooling industry with intention and innovation. With over 30 years of experience,
we deliver intelligent, sustainable cooling solutions engineered for long-lasting performance across
critical industries—from hyperscale data centers to K-12 education facilities and telecommunications
networks.

conditioning, refrigeration and their allied fields.

**Vision:** A healthy and sustainable built environment for all.

Have a funding request to be considered? The ASHRAE Foundation Board of Trustees will consider
funding requests if discretionary funds are available and the program/project furthers the mission

### High-performance Sequences of Operation for HVAC Systems

Guideline 36-2024 provides uniform sequences of operation for HVAC systems that maximize the
systems' energy efficiency and performance, provide control stability, and allow for real-time fault
diagnostics.

ASHRAE 365 is your go to source for the latest ASHRAE news and conference information. Download the
free app for year round updates and stay connected to everything happening across ASHRAE.

industry standards are shaped. Register by July 31 to save $60!

available! Learn how hydronic radiant systems create healthier, more comfortable indoor environments
while reducing energy consumption.

## Manage & Support

Taking consulting, design, and procurement and making it a reality is where C&T Design excels for
our diverse client base.  On-site project management, in-office project coordination, and a high
acumen for the Construction Industry are just a few of the tasks that get our clients open on time
and on budget.

I just wanted to send a note of appreciation to you.  Daniel Sahm, as a professional representative

1985: Willie and Susan Haughey establish City Refrigeration Holdings (UK) Ltd in Glasgow, UK.

1995: City UK launches long term partnership with Asda, one of the country's leading supermarket
retailers, to provide total FM services across more than 600 locations in the UK.

2005: City UK establishes its construction and engineering division, providing innovative solutions
across multiple sectors in the UK.

2009: City UK provides multi-site FM services throughout the country to Booker wholesalers and BP
petrol forecourt operators.

2011: City UK begins the provision of dedicated FM and cleaning services across the distribution
network of Asda supermarkets.

2017: City UK confirms the acquisition of Lesprit Ltd, trading as Maintenance Management Ltd (MML)
and Atrium Maintenance France (AMF) based in Milton Keynes (UK) and Lille (France) respectively.

2019: City UK signs deal with Marks & Spencer servicing 1000 sites.

supermarkets across the country.

across the country.

2015: City Australia establishes its partnership with Target, servicing over 300 stores across the
country.

2016: City Australia expands its partnership with Coles, servicing all its regional Distribution
Centres across the country.

2016: City Australia signs a new 10-year partnership deal with Coles. This deal represents one of
the largest GNFR contracts signed by Coles.

2017: City Australia renews its partnership with Target for another 10 years.

2018: City Australia commences cleaning self-delivery to Coles Distribution Centres throughout the
country.

2019: City Australia signs its first healthcare partnership with the Australian Red Cross Lifeblood.

2019: City Australia establishes its partnership with mycar, servicing 260 sites.

#### Europe

×

1985: Willie and Susan Haughey establish City Refrigeration Holdings (UK) Ltd in Glasgow, UK.

1995: City UK launches long term partnership with Asda, one of the country's leading supermarket
retailers, to provide total FM services across more than 600 locations in the UK.

2005: City UK establishes its construction and engineering division, providing innovative solutions
across multiple sectors in the UK.

2009: City UK provides multi-site FM services throughout the country to Booker wholesalers and BP
petrol forecourt operators.

2011: City UK begins the provision of dedicated FM and cleaning services across the distribution
network of Asda supermarkets.

2017: City UK confirms the acquisition of Lesprit Ltd, trading as Maintenance Management Ltd (MML)
and Atrium Maintenance France (AMF) based in Milton Keynes (UK) and Lille (France) respectively.

2019: City UK signs deal with Marks & Spencer servicing 1000 sites.

#### Australia

×

2009: City Australia launches in Melbourne, in partnership with Coles, servicing over 700
supermarkets across the country.

2015: City Australia expands its partnership with Coles, servicing all Liquorand and Express stores
across the country.

2015: City Australia establishes its partnership with Target, servicing over 300 stores across the
country.

2016: City Australia expands its partnership with Coles, servicing all its regional Distribution
Centres across the country.

2016: City Australia signs a new 10-year partnership deal with Coles. This deal represents one of
the largest GNFR contracts signed by Coles.

2017: City Australia renews its partnership with Target for another 10 years.

2018: City Australia commences cleaning self-delivery to Coles Distribution Centres throughout the
country.

2019: City Australia signs its first healthcare partnership with the Australian Red Cross Lifeblood.

2019: City Australia establishes its partnership with mycar, servicing 260 sites.

#### Asia

×

2015: City Asia launches in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, in partnership with Dairy Farm, servicing over
205 supermarkets across the region.

2017: City Asia commences service delivery to 450 Guardian health and beauty sites in Malaysia.

2018: City Asia expands its partnership with Dairy Farm, servicing 630 sites in Singapore.

2019: City Asia expands its partnership with Dairy Farm, servicing over 1800 sites in Hong Kong.

# The Clean Cooling reference
# at European level

We want an ambitious EU legislation fostering innovation and maintaining global HVAC&R leadership.

[ Find out more ][16]
[ Our Members ][17]

## Refrigerants

We believe the fastest way to decarbonise the heating and cooling sectors is to foster the use of
natural refrigerants across all segments of the HVAC&R industry.

[ Learn more ][18]

We share the concern on per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) by five European countries’
chemical authorities in charge of drafting the Restriction Intention. This regulatory measure is
likely to affect most of the fluorinated synthetic refrigerants in use today, and we support this
effort aimed at tackling the reduction of these fluorinated substances.

## REACH

[ Learn More ][19]
[Training]

## Training

As regulatory efforts on fluorinated gases at global level (Kigali Amendment to the Montreal
Protocol) and at European Union level (EU F-Gas Regulation and REACH Restriction Intention) set the
path for all HVAC&R industry’s stakeholders, the long-term viability of these substances is in
question. The need to increasingly grow the number of HVAC&R’s experts within the clean cooling and
natural refrigerants sector is therefore evident.

[ Learn More ][20]

## Announcements

[
[Clean cooling coalition position paper post image]
][21]

##### [ The Revised EU F-gas Has Been Published in the Official Journal of the EU ][22]

The Revised EU F-gas is now law and will be enforceable as of March 11. It introduces many
improvements aimed at supporting natural refrigerants.

[ Read More » ][23]
[
[EU F-Gas proposal]
][24]

##### [ CCC Reacts to EU F-gas Provisional Agreement ][25]

With a phase out of HFCs understood to be agreed upon, and bans on all f-gases, the new F-gas
Regulation will contribute to support deployment of natural refrigerants.

[ Read More » ][26]
[
[CCC EU F-gas Trilogue Ambition]
][27]

##### [ CCC Members Support Ambition in a Letter for the EU F-gas Trilogue ][28]

Some members of the Clean Cooling Coalition have joined forces with other like-minded companies
asking EU policymakers to support innovation without F-gases.

[ Read More » ][29]
[
[California F-gas Free SB1206]
][30]

##### [ California SB1206: Request for Comments to Transition California’s Economy to Low-GWP or
##### No-GWP Refrigerants ][31]

Stakeholders feedback is welcomed in the development of the assessment report required by the bill.

[ Read More » ][32]

[ Learn more ][18]

We share the concern on per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) by five European countries’
chemical authorities in charge of drafting the Restriction Intention. This regulatory measure is
likely to affect most of the fluorinated synthetic refrigerants in use today, and we support this
effort aimed at tackling the reduction of these fluorinated substances.

## REACH

Protocol) and at European Union level (EU F-Gas Regulation and REACH Restriction Intention) set the

question. The need to increasingly grow the number of HVAC&R’s experts within the clean cooling and

# Color Meanings – Discover the Power and Symbolism Behind Every Hue

[Color Meanings]

Colors play an exceptionally prominent role in our lives. They influence our thinking, inspire our
decision-making, and impact our moods. From causing changes to changing reactions, colors are more
powerful than we think. Depending on our interpretations, they can be used for both good and evil.
Fortunately, we have the power to welcome some colors and shun others. This guide will take you on a
journey through the exciting universe of color meanings.

It’s important to note that not all colors were created equal. Though some shades are similar, that
doesn’t mean they’ll awaken the same emotions. To truly grasp the meaning of color, we must learn to
accept this. It’s also imperative to relinquish some control. Try as we might, we won’t always have
a handle on our emotions. Colors have such a substantial effect on the mind and body, and until we
make our peace with this reality, we’ll remain forever perplexed by inexplicable and random
reactions.

**You can read about each color meaning by clicking the links below:**
1.  [Red][26]
2.  [Orange][27]
3.  [Yellow][28]
4.  [Green][29]
5.  [Turquoise][30]
6.  [Blue][31]
7.  [Purple][32]
8.  [Pink][33]
9.  [Brown][34]
10. [Black][35]
11. [Gray][36]
12. [White][37]

## Recognizing Your Responses

Have you ever noticed a shift in your attitude while surrounded by a particular color? Perhaps
you’ve been overwhelmed with nostalgia while staring at a specific shade. You’ve likely written
these occurrences off as a common human response, but the cause is far more complex than that. Color
psychology teaches us that much of human behavior is dictated by color. When we open our minds to
this possibility, we begin to understand the scope of our perceptions.

## Personal Cognizance

Once we acknowledge that colors influence doings, it makes way for personal interpretations. In
other words, we level the playing field by regaining some control of how we react to colors. You may
realize that the color red triggers anger. To avoid unnecessary bouts of rage, limit your encounters
with this hue. On the other hand, yellow might make you feel cheery and upbeat. If so, introduce
more of this color into your life. With a healthy dose of awareness, you can somewhat manage the
moods and emotions that colors produce.

## Uncovering New Meanings

The psychology behind color is fascinating and ever-expanding. With that said, new meanings are
always coming to light. The more knowledge we acquire, the more informed we become. This prospect
promises great hope for future research.

What’s more, our minds are in a perpetual state of evolvement. In essence, though some colors have
fixed explanations, these findings can always shift. This fact is both unsettling and reassuring. As
researchers continue to delve into the many facets of the color wheel, new information is
continually revealing itself.

## Diversify Your Understandings

While reading these articles, you’ll develop a deeper understanding of what colors mean, how they
make an impression on us, and the ways we perceive them. The notion that colors are so dynamic may
seem absurd to some, but there’s no refuting this truth. This concept often eludes us because we
don’t realize how frequently colors control us. Certain hues can evoke fond memories. Others may
give rise to dreadful feelings.

## An Overview of Color Meanings

To help you discover the celebrated phenomenon of colors, here’s an overview of each color’s
meaning, what it symbolizes, and how it affects human emotion and behavior.

### 1. Red Color Meaning

The color of passion and energy. Red draws attention like no other color and radiates a strong and
powerful energy that motivates us to take action. It is also linked to sexuality and stimulates deep
and intimate passion. Red is ubiquitously used to warn and signal caution and danger.

[Read more about the color red][39]

[[Orange Color Meaning Infographic][Orange Color Meaning Infographic]][40]

The color of enthusiasm and emotion. Orange exudes warmth and joy and is considered a fun color that
provides emotional strength. It is optimistic and upliftning, adds spontaneity and positivity to
life and it encourages social communication and creativity. It is a youthful and energetic color.

### 1. Red Color Meaning

[[Red Color Meaning Infographic][Red Color Meaning Infographic]][38]

The color of passion and energy. Red draws attention like no other color and radiates a strong and
powerful energy that motivates us to take action. It is also linked to sexuality and stimulates deep
and intimate passion. Red is ubiquitously used to warn and signal caution and danger.

[Read more about the color red][39]

### 2. Orange Color Meaning

[[Orange Color Meaning Infographic][Orange Color Meaning Infographic]][40]

The color of enthusiasm and emotion. Orange exudes warmth and joy and is considered a fun color that
provides emotional strength. It is optimistic and upliftning, adds spontaneity and positivity to
life and it encourages social communication and creativity. It is a youthful and energetic color.

[Read more about the color orange][41]

### 3. Yellow Color Meaning

[[Yellow Color Meaning Infographic][Yellow Color Meaning Infographic]][42]

The color of happiness and optimism. Yellow is a cheerful and energetic color that brings fun and
joy to the world. It makes learning easier as it affects the logical part of the brain, stimulating
mentality and perception. It inspires thought and curiosity and boosts enthusiasm and confidence.

[Read more about the color yellow][43]

### 4. Green Color Meaning

[[Green Color Meaning Infographic][Green Color Meaning Infographic]][44]

The color of harmony and health. Green is a generous, relaxing color that revitalizes our body and
mind. It balances our emotions and leaves us feeling safe and secure. It also gives us hope, with
promises of growth and prosperity, and it provides a little bit of luck to help us along the way.

[Read more about the color green][45]

### 5. Turquoise Color Meaning

[[Turquoise Color Meaning Infographic][Turquoise Color Meaning Infographic]][46]

The color of calmness and clarity. Turquoise stabilizes emotions and increases empathy and
compassion. It emits a cool calming peace, gives us a boost of positive mental energy that improves
concentration and clarifies our mind, and creates a balance that clears the path to spiritual
growth.

[Read more about the color turquoise][47]

### 6. Blue Color Meaning

[[Blue Color Meaning Infographic][Blue Color Meaning Infographic]][48]

The color of trust and loyalty. Blue has a calming and relaxing effect on our psyche, that gives us
peace and makes us feel confident and secure. It dislikes confrontation and too much attention, but
it is an honest, reliable and responsible color and you can always count on its support.

[Read more about the color blue][49]

### 7. Purple Color Meaning

[[Purple Color Meaning Infographic][Purple Color Meaning Infographic]][50]

The color of spirituality and imagination. Purple inspires us to divulge our innermost thoughts,
which enlightens us with wisdom of who we are and encourages spiritual growth. It is often
associated with royalty and luxury, and its mystery and magic sparks creative fantasies.

[Read more about the color purple][51]

### 8. Pink Color Meaning

[[Pink Color Meaning Infographic][Pink Color Meaning Infographic]][52]

The color of love and compassion. Pink is kind and comforting, full of sympathy and compassion, and
makes us feel accepted. Its friendly, playful spirit calms and nurtures us, bringing joy and warmth
into our lives. Pink is also a feminine and intuitive color that is bursting with pure romance.

[Read more about the color pink][53]

### 9. Brown Color Meaning

[[Brown Color Meaning Infographic][Brown Color Meaning Infographic]][54]

The color of stability and reliability. Brown is dependable and comforting. A great counselor and
friend full of wisdom. You can count on its help if you need an honest opinion, support and
protection. It stabilizes us, helps us stay grounded and inspires us to appreciate the simple things
in life.

[Read more about the color brown][55]

### 10. Black Color Meaning

[[Black Color Meaning Infographic][Black Color Meaning Infographic]][56]

The color of power and sophistication. Black is an incredibly strong and intimidating color that
exudes authority and makes us feel secure and protected. Often seen at formal and prestigious
events, this mysterious marvel arouses and seduces our senses with its elegance and sexiness.

[Read more about the color black][57]

### 11. Gray Color Meaning

[[Gray Color Meaning Infographic][Gray Color Meaning Infographic]][58]

The color of compromise and control. Gray is neutral, conservative and unemotional. It is
practically solid as a rock, making it incredibly stable, reliable and calming. It has a peaceful,
relaxing and soothing presence. Gray avoids attention but offers mature, insightful advice to anyone
who asks.

[Read more about the color gray][59]

### 12. White Color Meaning

[[White Color Meaning Infographic][White Color Meaning Infographic]][60]

The color of purity and innocence. White is a true balance of all colors and is associated with
cleanliness, simplicity and perfection. It loves to make others feel good and provides hope and
clarity by refreshing and purifying the mind. It also promotes open-mindedness and self-reflection.

[Read more about the color white][61]

## Explore the World of Colors

Colors are an incredibly detailed subject and an endless source of fascination. If you want to learn
more about color meanings and how they affect us every day, check out this [color symbolism
chart][62]. If you’re interested in learning how to pick the best colors for your designs, begin
reading about [color theory][63]. If you need to find some color codes for a design, here’s a [list

# Color Meanings – Discover the Power and Symbolism Behind Every Hue

[Color Meanings]

Colors play an exceptionally prominent role in our lives. They influence our thinking, inspire our
decision-making, and impact our moods. From causing changes to changing reactions, colors are more
powerful than we think. Depending on our interpretations, they can be used for both good and evil.
Fortunately, we have the power to welcome some colors and shun others. This guide will take you on a
journey through the exciting universe of color meanings.

It’s important to note that not all colors were created equal. Though some shades are similar, that
doesn’t mean they’ll awaken the same emotions. To truly grasp the meaning of color, we must learn to
accept this. It’s also imperative to relinquish some control. Try as we might, we won’t always have
a handle on our emotions. Colors have such a substantial effect on the mind and body, and until we
make our peace with this reality, we’ll remain forever perplexed by inexplicable and random
reactions.

**You can read about each color meaning by clicking the links below:**
1.  [Red][26]
2.  [Orange][27]
3.  [Yellow][28]
4.  [Green][29]
5.  [Turquoise][30]
6.  [Blue][31]
7.  [Purple][32]
8.  [Pink][33]
9.  [Brown][34]
10. [Black][35]
11. [Gray][36]
12. [White][37]

## Recognizing Your Responses

Have you ever noticed a shift in your attitude while surrounded by a particular color? Perhaps
you’ve been overwhelmed with nostalgia while staring at a specific shade. You’ve likely written
these occurrences off as a common human response, but the cause is far more complex than that. Color
psychology teaches us that much of human behavior is dictated by color. When we open our minds to
this possibility, we begin to understand the scope of our perceptions.

## Personal Cognizance

Once we acknowledge that colors influence doings, it makes way for personal interpretations. In
other words, we level the playing field by regaining some control of how we react to colors. You may
realize that the color red triggers anger. To avoid unnecessary bouts of rage, limit your encounters
with this hue. On the other hand, yellow might make you feel cheery and upbeat. If so, introduce
more of this color into your life. With a healthy dose of awareness, you can somewhat manage the
moods and emotions that colors produce.

## Uncovering New Meanings

The psychology behind color is fascinating and ever-expanding. With that said, new meanings are
always coming to light. The more knowledge we acquire, the more informed we become. This prospect
promises great hope for future research.

What’s more, our minds are in a perpetual state of evolvement. In essence, though some colors have
fixed explanations, these findings can always shift. This fact is both unsettling and reassuring. As
researchers continue to delve into the many facets of the color wheel, new information is
continually revealing itself.

## Diversify Your Understandings

While reading these articles, you’ll develop a deeper understanding of what colors mean, how they
make an impression on us, and the ways we perceive them. The notion that colors are so dynamic may
seem absurd to some, but there’s no refuting this truth. This concept often eludes us because we
don’t realize how frequently colors control us. Certain hues can evoke fond memories. Others may
give rise to dreadful feelings.

## An Overview of Color Meanings

To help you discover the celebrated phenomenon of colors, here’s an overview of each color’s
meaning, what it symbolizes, and how it affects human emotion and behavior.

### 1. Red Color Meaning

[[Red Color Meaning Infographic][Red Color Meaning Infographic]][38]

The color of passion and energy. Red draws attention like no other color and radiates a strong and
powerful energy that motivates us to take action. It is also linked to sexuality and stimulates deep
and intimate passion. Red is ubiquitously used to warn and signal caution and danger.

[Read more about the color red][39]

### 2. Orange Color Meaning

[[Orange Color Meaning Infographic][Orange Color Meaning Infographic]][40]

The color of enthusiasm and emotion. Orange exudes warmth and joy and is considered a fun color that
provides emotional strength. It is optimistic and upliftning, adds spontaneity and positivity to
life and it encourages social communication and creativity. It is a youthful and energetic color.

[Read more about the color orange][41]

## An Overview of Color Meanings

To help you discover the celebrated phenomenon of colors, here’s an overview of each color’s
meaning, what it symbolizes, and how it affects human emotion and behavior.

### 1. Red Color Meaning

[[Red Color Meaning Infographic][Red Color Meaning Infographic]][38]

The color of passion and energy. Red draws attention like no other color and radiates a strong and
powerful energy that motivates us to take action. It is also linked to sexuality and stimulates deep
and intimate passion. Red is ubiquitously used to warn and signal caution and danger.

[Read more about the color red][39]

### 2. Orange Color Meaning

[[Orange Color Meaning Infographic][Orange Color Meaning Infographic]][40]

The color of enthusiasm and emotion. Orange exudes warmth and joy and is considered a fun color that
provides emotional strength. It is optimistic and upliftning, adds spontaneity and positivity to
life and it encourages social communication and creativity. It is a youthful and energetic color.

[Read more about the color orange][41]

### 3. Yellow Color Meaning

[[Yellow Color Meaning Infographic][Yellow Color Meaning Infographic]][42]

The color of happiness and optimism. Yellow is a cheerful and energetic color that brings fun and
joy to the world. It makes learning easier as it affects the logical part of the brain, stimulating
mentality and perception. It inspires thought and curiosity and boosts enthusiasm and confidence.

[Read more about the color yellow][43]

### 4. Green Color Meaning

[[Green Color Meaning Infographic][Green Color Meaning Infographic]][44]

The color of harmony and health. Green is a generous, relaxing color that revitalizes our body and
mind. It balances our emotions and leaves us feeling safe and secure. It also gives us hope, with
promises of growth and prosperity, and it provides a little bit of luck to help us along the way.

[Read more about the color green][45]

### 5. Turquoise Color Meaning

[[Turquoise Color Meaning Infographic][Turquoise Color Meaning Infographic]][46]

The color of calmness and clarity. Turquoise stabilizes emotions and increases empathy and
compassion. It emits a cool calming peace, gives us a boost of positive mental energy that improves
concentration and clarifies our mind, and creates a balance that clears the path to spiritual
growth.

[Read more about the color turquoise][47]

### 6. Blue Color Meaning

[[Blue Color Meaning Infographic][Blue Color Meaning Infographic]][48]

The color of trust and loyalty. Blue has a calming and relaxing effect on our psyche, that gives us
peace and makes us feel confident and secure. It dislikes confrontation and too much attention, but
it is an honest, reliable and responsible color and you can always count on its support.

[Read more about the color blue][49]

### 7. Purple Color Meaning

[[Purple Color Meaning Infographic][Purple Color Meaning Infographic]][50]

The color of spirituality and imagination. Purple inspires us to divulge our innermost thoughts,
which enlightens us with wisdom of who we are and encourages spiritual growth. It is often
associated with royalty and luxury, and its mystery and magic sparks creative fantasies.

[Read more about the color purple][51]

### 8. Pink Color Meaning

[[Pink Color Meaning Infographic][Pink Color Meaning Infographic]][52]

The color of love and compassion. Pink is kind and comforting, full of sympathy and compassion, and
makes us feel accepted. Its friendly, playful spirit calms and nurtures us, bringing joy and warmth
into our lives. Pink is also a feminine and intuitive color that is bursting with pure romance.

[Read more about the color pink][53]

### 9. Brown Color Meaning

[[Brown Color Meaning Infographic][Brown Color Meaning Infographic]][54]

The color of stability and reliability. Brown is dependable and comforting. A great counselor and
friend full of wisdom. You can count on its help if you need an honest opinion, support and
protection. It stabilizes us, helps us stay grounded and inspires us to appreciate the simple things
in life.

[Read more about the color brown][55]

### 10. Black Color Meaning

[[Black Color Meaning Infographic][Black Color Meaning Infographic]][56]

The color of power and sophistication. Black is an incredibly strong and intimidating color that
exudes authority and makes us feel secure and protected. Often seen at formal and prestigious
events, this mysterious marvel arouses and seduces our senses with its elegance and sexiness.

[Read more about the color black][57]

### 11. Gray Color Meaning

[[Gray Color Meaning Infographic][Gray Color Meaning Infographic]][58]

The color of compromise and control. Gray is neutral, conservative and unemotional. It is
practically solid as a rock, making it incredibly stable, reliable and calming. It has a peaceful,
relaxing and soothing presence. Gray avoids attention but offers mature, insightful advice to anyone
who asks.

[Read more about the color gray][59]

### 12. White Color Meaning

[[White Color Meaning Infographic][White Color Meaning Infographic]][60]

The color of purity and innocence. White is a true balance of all colors and is associated with
cleanliness, simplicity and perfection. It loves to make others feel good and provides hope and
clarity by refreshing and purifying the mind. It also promotes open-mindedness and self-reflection.

[Read more about the color white][61]

Colors are an incredibly detailed subject and an endless source of fascination. If you want to learn

Climalife is one of the UK’s leading distributors of refrigerants, including [low and very low GWP
refrigerants][43], [HFO blends][44] and [A2Ls][45] on the market. 

 

Climalife sells [car air conditioning refrigerants][46] (such as [R1234yf][47]), [heat transfer
fluids][48], [compressor oils][49], [equipment and controls][50], [cleaning products][51], [aerosol
propellants][52], industrial gases and [blowing agents][53] to sectors including refrigeration, air
conditioning, heating, renewable energy, heat pumps and manufacturing. 

 

Climalife in the UK is a wholly owned subsidiary of the [Dehon Group][54] who are one of the largest
packers and fillers of refrigerants in Europe.

### Refrigeration Systems

Neil Roberts, Technical Sales Director at Climalife explains.

For many industrial refrigeration systems, using B2L, A3 or low GWP refrigerants (A1 or A2L), a
chiller with a secondary cooling circuit is often necessary. These indirect refrigeration systems
rely on heat transfer fluids (HTFs) to carry thermal energy between the refrigerant and the
application. Yet, while refrigerant choice is carefully considered, the HTF is often overlooked,
despite its significant impact on sustainability, efficiency, and compliance.

# Color Psychology: A Guide for Designers, Marketers & Students

A good rule of thumb for many Westerners is this: wear black to a funeral. Black, in this context,
signifies solemnity; it’s how we show that we’re grieving and respecting that of those around us.
Weddings, on the other hand, are known for white – but only for the bride! While the bride wears
white to symbolize purity and uphold tradition, wearing white as a guest is often seen as an attempt
at pulling attention away from the ceremony, which can be considered gravely insulting depending on
one’s company.

Wardrobe, of course, is far from the only place in our lives where color comes into play. But the
point still stands: color is vital to the human experience. Through color, we feel; we communicate;
and we heal. Those in advertising use it to sell products; those in schools and offices use it to
increase productivity.

When it comes to communication, color is unbeatable. Unconscious or otherwise, color can evoke
emotions, inspire reactions, and change modes of thinking. It can excite or soothe your mood, raise
or lower your blood pressure, and even whet your appetite! Whether it’s innate or learned, it’s
undeniable that color has a vital impact on how we go about our lives.

With the basics of the color theory under your belt, you can approach the psychology of individual
colors with a bit more nuance. As we’ve established, color is far from just a visual experience; it
can affect your mood, your wants, your reactions, and so on. However, such a powerful tool is wasted
if you don’t know how to use it effectively.

As such, knowing the personality and psychological effects of different colors – including various
shades and tints popular with producers and consumers alike – is vital!

Consider the following list a table of contents of sorts. This will be your point of reference from
which to navigate the depths of color psychology.

## [The Color Psychology of Red][199]

From the start of the rainbow to the ubiquitous advertising for Valentine’s Day, red remains one of
the most evocative colors on the visible spectrum. As a primary color, red is a color entirely its
own – that is to say, no other colors can come together to form a perfect red. In RGB, red is
comprised of 100% red, 0% green, and 0% blue.
* Associated with energy, war, danger, strength, power, determination, as well as passion, desire,
  and love.
* It enhances human metabolism, increases respiration rate, and raises blood pressure.
* It attracts attention more than any other color, at times signifying danger.

Popular [shades of red][200]: Magenta, Burgundy, Maroon.

[ Read more about the color red >>
][201]

## [The Color Psychology of Green][202]

Green is the primary color that hints at our primitive relationship with the first creation of the
world – nature. Considered the key color that represents purity, health, and freshness, green has
been traditionally associated with brands that encourage growth, vitality, and productivity (think
Starbucks and EverNote!).

Gentle, invigorating, and relaxing, green also represents connection. Connection to ourselves, to
the quiet moments in our lives, to nature itself. It is not a mere coincidence that people evade the
concrete jungle of big cities to disconnect from the mundane and connect to the wilderness of
nature. Green means the return to the primal roots, to the pristine kingdom of inner peace and
tranquillity.
* Color of nature. It symbolizes growth, harmony, freshness, and fertility.
* Considered beneficial to the mind and body.
* Slows human metabolism and produces a calming effect.
* Strongly associated with tranquility and calmness.
* Used to symbolize piety and sincerity.

Popular [shades of green][203]: Chartreuse

[ Read more about the color green >>
][204]

## [The Color Psychology of Blue][205]

In contrast to its sister primary color, red, blue is associated with a calm serenity over intensity
or passion. When asked to visualize a tranquil scene, chances are people will immediately imagine a
great deal of blue – usually in the form of a still body of water. Thoughtful and still, blue
represents a sense of inner reflection. A great deal of research has indicated that this impact on
the body is indeed inverse to red’s, resulting in lower heart rates and even slower metabolisms.
* Unique and authentic
* Enthusiastic, sympathetic, and personal; they seek meaning and significance in life
* Warm, communicative, and compassionate; they care about what they do
* Idealistic, spiritual, and sincere; they value unity and integrity in their relationships
* Peaceful, flexible, and imaginative; they are natural romantics and nurturers

Popular [shades of blue][206]: Teal, Turquoise

[ Read more about the color blue >>
][207]

## [**The Color Psychology of Brown**][208]

Moving on to a more serious and imposing color, we arrive at brown, which no longer sends us
thinking of youthfulness and excitement. Traditionally associated with seriousness, stability, and
wisdom, brown is mostly worn by people who impose respect and appreciation through their status.
When you think of this color, you might envision a paternal figure or a grandfather in the middle of
the family.

Because families are centered on the stability and resourcefulness of the main male figure, most
people feel secure and stable when thinking about brown. Paternal figures who passed a certain age
also exude a sense of stability, but in the material sense – they have accumulated life experience
which is manifested in possessions and financial gain. Most people feel safe around people wearing
brown because they represent seriousness, reliability, and support.
* Associated with the traits of dependability, reliability, and resilience.
* Brown-lovers are most often reserved and not looking to attract attention to themselves.
* While light brown represents honesty and stability, dark brown is considered mature, predictable,
  and dull

[ Read more about the color brown >>
][209]

## [The Color Psychology of Orange][210]

Bright and persuasive, orange results from the combination of yellow and red. As we have seen in the
previous section, yellow denotes optimism and cheerfulness, while red can suggest intense feelings
of love and even dominance. Orange sits in the middle of those extremities: it promotes
rejuvenation, communication, and positivism. This color also enhances extraversion, allowing people
to let go of their inhibitions and express themselves more freely. 
* Combines the energy of red and the happiness of yellow.
* Associated with joy, sunshine, and the tropics.
* Represents enthusiasm, fascination, happiness, creativity, determination, attraction, success,
  encouragement, and stimulation.

[ Read more about the color orange >>
][211]

## [The Color Psychology of Yellow][212]

“He is so bright” – Have you ever wondered where the association of increased mental capacity and
this particular visual adjective comes from? Yellow, the brightest color of the spectrum, is
commonly used in images depicting fresh ideas, creative projects, or new business initiatives. You
probably already know the prototypical image of someone brainstorming ideas that are linked with a
bright yellow bulb! This is not a random association: yellow has been scientifically proven by
studies to enhance mental activity and heighten awareness and energy levels.

The brightness of this color unclogs mental blocks and encourages people to seek new perspectives by
abandoning the dull ways of looking at the world. You can think of yellow as the main color of the
morning time when you are the most alert, insightful, and analytical, and when you have the chance
to create a brand new

# Color Psychology: A Guide for Designers, Marketers & Students

A good rule of thumb for many Westerners is this: wear black to a funeral. Black, in this context,
signifies solemnity; it’s how we show that we’re grieving and respecting that of those around us.
Weddings, on the other hand, are known for white – but only for the bride! While the bride wears
white to symbolize purity and uphold tradition, wearing white as a guest is often seen as an attempt
at pulling attention away from the ceremony, which can be considered gravely insulting depending on
one’s company.

Wardrobe, of course, is far from the only place in our lives where color comes into play. But the
point still stands: color is vital to the human experience. Through color, we feel; we communicate;
and we heal. Those in advertising use it to sell products; those in schools and offices use it to
increase productivity.

When it comes to communication, color is unbeatable. Unconscious or otherwise, color can evoke
emotions, inspire reactions, and change modes of thinking. It can excite or soothe your mood, raise
or lower your blood pressure, and even whet your appetite! Whether it’s innate or learned, it’s
undeniable that color has a vital impact on how we go about our lives.

With the basics of the color theory under your belt, you can approach the psychology of individual
colors with a bit more nuance. As we’ve established, color is far from just a visual experience; it
can affect your mood, your wants, your reactions, and so on. However, such a powerful tool is wasted
if you don’t know how to use it effectively.

As such, knowing the personality and psychological effects of different colors – including various
shades and tints popular with producers and consumers alike – is vital!

Consider the following list a table of contents of sorts. This will be your point of reference from
which to navigate the depths of color psychology.

## [The Color Psychology of Red][199]

From the start of the rainbow to the ubiquitous advertising for Valentine’s Day, red remains one of
the most evocative colors on the visible spectrum. As a primary color, red is a color entirely its
own – that is to say, no other colors can come together to form a perfect red. In RGB, red is
comprised of 100% red, 0% green, and 0% blue.
* Associated with energy, war, danger, strength, power, determination, as well as passion, desire,
  and love.
* It enhances human metabolism, increases respiration rate, and raises blood pressure.
* It attracts attention more than any other color, at times signifying danger.

Popular [shades of red][200]: Magenta, Burgundy, Maroon.

[ Read more about the color red >>
][201]

## [The Color Psychology of Green][202]

Green is the primary color that hints at our primitive relationship with the first creation of the
world – nature. Considered the key color that represents purity, health, and freshness, green has
been traditionally associated with brands that encourage growth, vitality, and productivity (think
Starbucks and EverNote!).

Gentle, invigorating, and relaxing, green also represents connection. Connection to ourselves, to
the quiet moments in our lives, to nature itself. It is not a mere coincidence that people evade the
concrete jungle of big cities to disconnect from the mundane and connect to the wilderness of
nature. Green means the return to the primal roots, to the pristine kingdom of inner peace and
tranquillity.
* Color of nature. It symbolizes growth, harmony, freshness, and fertility.
* Considered beneficial to the mind and body.
* Slows human metabolism and produces a calming effect.
* Strongly associated with tranquility and calmness.
* Used to symbolize piety and sincerity.

Popular [shades of green][203]: Chartreuse

[ Read more about the color green >>
][204]

## [The Color Psychology of Blue][205]

In contrast to its sister primary color, red, blue is associated with a calm serenity over intensity
or passion. When asked to visualize a tranquil scene, chances are people will immediately imagine a
great deal of blue – usually in the form of a still body of water. Thoughtful and still, blue
represents a sense of inner reflection. A great deal of research has indicated that this impact on
the body is indeed inverse to red’s, resulting in lower heart rates and even slower metabolisms.
* Unique and authentic
* Enthusiastic, sympathetic, and personal; they seek meaning and significance in life
* Warm, communicative, and compassionate; they care about what they do
* Idealistic, spiritual, and sincere; they value unity and integrity in their relationships
* Peaceful, flexible, and imaginative; they are natural romantics and nurturers

Popular [shades of blue][206]: Teal, Turquoise

[ Read more about the color blue >>
][207]

## [**The Color Psychology of Brown**][208]

Moving on to a more serious and imposing color, we arrive at brown, which no longer sends us
thinking of youthfulness and excitement. Traditionally associated with seriousness, stability, and
wisdom, brown is mostly worn by people who impose respect and appreciation through their status.
When you think of this color, you might envision a paternal figure or a grandfather in the middle of
the family.

Because families are centered on the stability and resourcefulness of the main male figure, most
people feel secure and stable when thinking about brown. Paternal figures who passed a certain age
also exude a sense of stability, but in the material sense – they have accumulated life experience
which is manifested in possessions and financial gain. Most people feel safe around people wearing
brown because they represent seriousness, reliability, and support.
* Associated with the traits of dependability, reliability, and resilience.
* Brown-lovers are most often reserved and not looking to attract attention to themselves.
* While light brown represents honesty and stability, dark brown is considered mature, predictable,
  and dull

[ Read more about the color brown >>
][209]

## [The Color Psychology of Orange][210]

Bright and persuasive, orange results from the combination of yellow and red. As we have seen in the
previous section, yellow denotes optimism and cheerfulness, while red can suggest intense feelings
of love and even dominance. Orange sits in the middle of those extremities: it promotes
rejuvenation, communication, and positivism. This color also enhances extraversion, allowing people
to let go of their inhibitions and express themselves more freely. 
* Combines the energy of red and the happiness of yellow.
* Associated with joy, sunshine, and the tropics.
* Represents enthusiasm, fascination, happiness, creativity, determination, attraction, success,
  encouragement, and stimulation.

[ Read more about the color orange >>
][211]

“He is so bright” – Have you ever wondered where the association of increased mental capacity and
this particular visual adjective comes from? Yellow, the brightest color of the spectrum, is
commonly used in images depicting fresh ideas, creative projects, or new business initiatives. You
probably already know the prototypical image of someone brainstorming ideas that are linked with a
bright yellow bulb! This is not a random association: yellow has been scientifically proven by
studies to enhance mental activity and heighten awareness and energy levels.

  There’s no use in crying over spoiled milk. With Cryopak´s temperature and humidity monitoring

# Cold Chain Packaging Design, Engineering and Testing

Cryopak is a complete cold chain packaging solutions provider specializing in the field of
temperature-controlled packaging. From needs assessment to package qualification, Cryopak handles
your packaging projects with one paramount goal: Maintaining the integrity of your products. Our
materials and processes cover the spectrum from converting EPS or fabricating boxes to manufacturing
phase change materials and temperature monitors.

  Prevent mold growth without drying out the cannabinoids and terpenes, and increase shelf life by
  transporting your products within the proper temperature and humidity ranges, with our
  specifically design pallet shippers and insulated boxes.
* ### Serving the Pharmaceutical Industry
  
  The pharmaceutical industry demands stringent monitoring of your payload’s temperature. Just one
  degree off can spoil products and cause financial losses. Don’t risk it. Let Cryopak provide you
  with accurate monitoring solutions.
* ### Providing Premium Retail Products
  
  Our Ice-Pak Brand is an integral part of any lunch box or cooler. From bottles and blankets to hot
  packs and coolers, we have the solution for your every need.
* ### Keeping Food & Beverage Cold
  
  There’s no use in crying over spoiled milk. With Cryopak´s temperature and humidity monitoring
  solutions, you can track the enviroment of your product in real-time.

# The natural refrigerant that just works in the systems you already own.

Eco Kold is an engineered hydrocarbon blend with a Global Warming Potential of <1. It's a direct,
drop-in retrofit across five blends covering R-22, R-410A, R-404, and R-134/R-134A. Lower energy,
lower emissions, longer equipment life. Already installed in hospitals, retail, and industrial
facilities across the Americas, Europe, and Asia.

The big picture

## Refrigerant progression.

Four generations of refrigerant chemistry, each graduating past the last. ODP is Ozone Depletion
Potential; GWP is Global Warming Potential.

CFCs
Banned
High ODPHigh GWP
HCFCs
Phased out
Low ODPHigh GWP
HFCs
Stop-gap
Low ODPHigh GWP
[Eco Kold]
HC · Natural refrigerant
Long-term solution
Zero ODPVery low GWP
**1987**Montreal Protocol signed; CFC production ends in the 1990s
**2020**US R-22 production and import end
**2022→**HFC phase-down steps begin under the AIM Act
**Today**HC natural refrigerants: the long-term path

Eco Kold blends are HC natural refrigerants: GWP under 1 and zero ODP. [Meet the blend family →][36]

On the customer's electric bill

## The numbers we put on a customer's electric bill: verified, audited, on the record.

We don't publish lab projections. Every efficiency claim on this site comes off a real customer's
utility bill, measured by an independent auditor. The current measurement cycle is underway; results
publish here the day they clear.

Field-measured · Same thermostat, same equipment · Independent auditor

The product line

## Five blends. One drop-in retrofit for nearly every system in the field.

Each Eco Kold blend is engineered to match the pressure, temperature, and oil compatibility of a
specific legacy refrigerant, so installation is a recharge, not a retrofit.
